asked.item: Only 60 credits shown during trial, no bonus

verdict.reason: S29-S31 state that promotional bonus credits from a signup offer are added when the paid subscription activates, and that only the 60 trial credits show during the trial.

steps.text: Yes, that is normal: during the free trial you see only the trial credit balance (60 credits).
Promotional bonus credits, such as extra credits from a signup offer, are added when your paid subscription activates, and they appear after the trial ends and your first payment processes.
